name: Cool, Dark Room Reset
equipment: Blackout curtains or an eye mask, if available
instructions: Lower the thermostat a degree or two tonight if your room has been running warm -- cooler rooms support deeper sleep.
Add an eye mask or blackout curtains if any light leaks into the room.
Remove or cover any small glowing lights (chargers, standby LEDs) within view of the bed.
Follow tonight's wind-down yoga flow once the room is set.
